HAPPY DIWALI
Peddakka

May Goddess Lakshmi fill your home with gold, your plate with sweets and your life with every blessing, and may a little of it, just a little, find its way to your hard-working younger brother.

Thank you for the endless scoldings, the free advice nobody asked for, and for being right 99% of the time. (The other 1% we shall never discuss.)

May your diyas glow brighter than your temper, and may your crackers be louder than your “I told you so”. 🪔

With all my respect, love and a tiny bit of fear,
your favourite (and only) little brother, Yaswanth ❤️
